mapper.sql:
where t.del_yn = 'N' and t.scope = 'PUBLIC'
and instr(lower(t.title), lower(#{keyword})) > 0
and exists (select 1 from trip_region r where r.trip_id = t.trip_id and r.region = #{region})
and p.day_count = #{days}
and p.day_count >= 4
mapper.select:
select t.trip_id, t.title, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.day_count, (select count(*) from trip_like l where l.trip_id = t.trip_id) as like_count from trip t join v_trip_period p on p.trip_id = t.trip_id
order by t.created_at desc, t.trip_id desc offset #{offset} rows fetch next #{pageSize} rows only
select count(*) from trip t join v_trip_period p on p.trip_id = t.trip_id
